fields.description: Observed vector width returned by the fixed Ollama nomic-embed-text model. Recorded after the first successful embedding request.
fields.label: Embedding Dimension

fields.description: Hybrid fuses vector similarity with keyword matching. Vector uses similarity alone.
fields.label: Search Type

fields.description: Where search vectors are stored: Auto (pgvector on Postgres, otherwise lancedb), lancedb, pgvector, chroma, or a backend registered by an installed app. After changing it, rebuild the knowledge index.
fields.label: Vector Backend

fields.description: Characters shared between consecutive chunks to preserve context across boundaries.
fields.label: Chunk Overlap

fields.description: Model that turns audio files into text. It must be served by an OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint (for example OpenAI, Groq or a local faster-whisper server). Audio is sent to that provider. Leave empty to keep audio uploads switched off.
fields.label: Transcription Model

fields.description: Largest audio file accepted, in megabytes. Keep it at or below your provider's limit (OpenAI: 25).
fields.label: Max Audio Size (MB)

fields.description: Seconds to wait for a transcription. Keep it below your web server's request timeout (120 by default).
fields.label: Transcription Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Model that speaks replies in voice mode. It must be served by an OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint (for example OpenAI tts-1 or a local Piper/Kokoro server). Reply text is sent to that provider. Leave empty to use the browser's own voice. Voice mode also needs a Transcription Model.
fields.label: Speech Model

fields.description: Voice name your speech model understands (OpenAI: alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer).
fields.label: Speech Voice

fields.description: Seconds before a non-streaming request to the service times out.
fields.label: Request Timeout (s)

fields.description: Seconds before an idle streaming connection to the service times out.
fields.label: Stream Timeout (s)

fields.description: Health indicator for the FastAPI service, updated by the health probe.
fields.label: Service Status
